summary: Pin is in steep garden bush above a narrow road; nowhere to pull off.
reasons: No tracks or vehicles to the pin
Road below has edge lines, no pull-off

drivers.seclusion: Dense planting, but the pin is on a hillside above visitor roads and car parks.
drivers.access_and_room: No track reaches the pin. The garden road 17 m away is narrow with yellow edge lines and no clear shoulder; car parks are 60-80 m off.
drivers.traffic: Garden road and car parks close; visitor traffic by day.
drivers.convention: Botanic garden; no sign of overnight stays.

flags: Yellow edge lines along the road (no-stopping style) in QLD imagery
No mapped buildings or gates nearby
sun_shade: Under dense tree canopy from all sides.
